quickSummary: Nucleotides comprise a nitrogenous base (Purines A/G, Pyrimidines C/T/U), pentose sugar, and phosphate group joined by 3',5'-phosphodiester bonds. Double-stranded DNA strictly obeys Chargaff's rules ([A]=[T], [G]=[C]). Standard B-DNA is a right-handed double helix with 2.0 nm diameter, 3.4 nm pitch (10 bp/turn), 0.34 nm axial rise, and A=T (2 H-bonds) / G≡C (3 H-bonds). Z-DNA is an alternating left-handed zig-zag helix with 12 bp/turn.

summaryBox.takeaway: Nucleoside = Base + Sugar. Nucleotide = Nucleoside + Phosphate. B-DNA = 2.0 nm diameter, 3.4 nm pitch, 10 bp/turn, 0.34 nm rise. Z-DNA = Left-handed zig-zag (12 bp/turn).

NUCLEOTIDE COMPONENTS
                                     │
         ┌───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┐
         ▼                           ▼                           ▼
  NITROGENOUS BASE              PENTOSE SUGAR              PHOSPHATE GROUP
  ├── Purines (A, G)            ├── $\text{D}$-Ribose (RNA) └── Phosphoric Acid ($\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4$)
  └── Pyrimidines (C, T, U)     └── $2'$-Deoxyribose (DNA)      Esters to $5'$-OH
conceptBreakdown.content:
Nucleic acids (DNA and RNA) are linear unbranched polymers of nucleotides.

### Nitrogenous Bases
• **Purines (9-Membered Double Ring)**: **Adenine** (6-aminopurine) and **Guanine** (2-amino-6-oxypurine).
• **Pyrimidines (6-Membered Single Ring)**: **Cytosine** (2-oxy-4-aminopyrimidine), **Thymine** (2,4-dioxy-5-methylpyrimidine in DNA), and **Uracil** (2,4-dioxypyrimidine in RNA).

### Molecular Equations
$$\text{Nucleoside} = \text{Nitrogenous Base} + \text{Pentose Sugar (via } \beta\text{-}N\text{-Glycosidic Bond)}$$
$$\text{Nucleotide} = \text{Nucleoside} + \text{Phosphate Group (via } 5'\text{-Phosphoester Bond)}$$

conceptBreakdown.heading: 5.1 Phosphodiester Linkages & Chargaff's Rules
conceptBreakdown.title: 5.1 Phosphodiester Linkages & Chargaff's Rules
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Phosphodiester Bond**: Nucleotides polymerize linearly by linking the 3'-hydroxyl ($-\text{OH}$) group of one sugar to the 5'-phosphate group of the next sugar via a **3',5'-phosphodiester bridge**.
• **Chargaff’s Rules (1950 — Applies EXCLUSIVELY to Double-Stranded DNA)**:
  1. $[\text{A}] + [\text{G}] = [\text{T}] + [\text{C}]$ (Total Purines = Total Pyrimidines).
  2. $[\text{A}] = [\text{T}]$ and $[\text{G}] = [\text{C}]$.
  3. Base ratio $\frac{[\text{A}]+[\text{T}]}{[\text{G}]+[\text{C}]}$ is constant for a given species (*$<1$ in GC-rich species; $>1$ in AT-rich species*).

conceptBreakdown.heading: 5.2 B-DNA Double Helix Parameters (Watson & Crick, 1953)
conceptBreakdown.title: 5.2 B-DNA Double Helix Parameters (Watson & Crick, 1953)
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
DNA DOUBLE HELIX DIAGRAM
                          
               5' ── P ─ Sugar ─ A ═ T ─ Sugar ─ P ── 3'
                        │                    │
               3' ── P ─ Sugar ─ G ≡ C ─ Sugar ─ P ── 5'
                        │                    │
                        └────── 2.0 nm ──────┘
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Strand Directionality**: Two antiparallel strands ($5'\rightarrow 3'$ and $3'\rightarrow 5'$).
• **Helical Diameter**: $2.0\text{ nm}$ ($20\ \text{\AA}$).
• **Pitch (One Full $360^\circ$ Turn)**: $3.4\text{ nm}$ ($34\ \text{\AA}$).
• **Base Pairs per Turn**: **10 bp per turn**.
• **Axial Rise per Base Pair**: $0.34\text{ nm}$ ($3.4\ \text{\AA}$).
• **Hydrogen Bonds**: $\text{A} = \text{T}$ (2 H-bonds); $\text{G} \equiv \text{C}$ (3 H-bonds).

conceptBreakdown.heading: 5.3 Structural Polymorphism of DNA (A, B, Z Forms)
conceptBreakdown.title: 5.3 Structural Polymorphism of DNA (A, B, Z Forms)
conceptBreakdown.content:
| Parameter | $A$-DNA | $B$-DNA (Physiological) | $Z$-DNA |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Helical Handedness** | **Right-handed** | **Right-handed** | **Left-handed** |
| **Helical Diameter** | $2.3\text{ nm}$ ($23\ \text{\AA}$) | $2.0\text{ nm}$ ($20\ \text{\AA}$) | $1.8\text{ nm}$ ($18\ \text{\AA}$) |
| **Base Pairs per Turn** | **$11\text{ bp}$** | **$10\text{ bp}$** ($10.5\text{ bp}$ in solution) | **$12\text{ bp}$** ($6$ dinucleotide dimers) |
| **Helical Pitch / Turn** | $2.8\text{ nm}$ ($28\ \text{\AA}$) | $3.4\text{ nm}$ ($34\ \text{\AA}$) | $4.5\text{ nm}$ ($45\ \text{\AA}$) |
| **Sugar Puckering** | $\text{C}-3'$ endo | $\text{C}-2'$ endo | Alternating $\text{C}-2'$ endo / $\text{C}-3'$ endo |
| **Backbone Geometry** | Smooth right-handed ribbon | Smooth right-handed ribbon | **Zig-Zag left-handed ribbon** |
| **Condition** | Dehydrated DNA fibers | Physiological hydrated state | Alternating purine-pyrimidine sequence ($\text{poly(dG-dC)}$) under high salt |
